description: Invite another avatar to be a roommate on your lot. Prerequisite: caller must be the current lot's owner (VMTSOLotState.OwnerID == self). Effect: creates a pending roommate invite; target's fso_roommates row appears with is_pending=1 until they accept or decline. Cost: one of your 8 roommate slots is reserved (including pending). Refuse path: ok=false if caller is not owner or target is already roommate-bound elsewhere. Wire: ChangeRoommateRequest{Type=INVITE,AvatarId,LotLocation} on the city Aries socket.
call_signatures: cf $CF add-roommate --target_persist_id <nearby_sims[].persist_id>                   # owner-only; sends ChangeRoommateRequest INVITE
common_mistakes: Calling as non-owner → handler returns ok:false ('caller is not lot owner').
target_persist_id == own persist_id → ok:false ('cannot invite yourself').
Roommate already invited/accepted elsewhere — server returns an error async; handler can't detect that locally.
perception_hints: Your own persist_id (to avoid self-targeting): perception.avatar.persist_id
Target persist_id: perception.nearby_sims[].persist_id for Sims physically on the lot
Relationships for picking a roommate candidate: perception.relationships[]
refuse_conditions: caller is not lot owner → returns ok:false with 'caller is not lot owner (owner_id=..., me=...)'
target_persist_id is 0 or missing → returns ok:false with 'requires target_persist_id (> 0)'
target_persist_id == caller's own avatar_id → returns ok:false with 'cannot self-target' / 'cannot invite yourself'
